newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police launch bomb alert at British base.
newsitem.headline: German police launch bomb alert at British base.

text.p: German police evacuated hundreds of people from their homes in a western town in the early hours of Wednesday morning after they discovered a stolen car they feared could contain a bomb outside a British barracks.
Police said the car, standing outside the British air force barracks in the North-Rhine Westphalian town of Niederkruechten, was being investigated by German and British experts.
The car, with British numberplates, was registered as stolen on March 24. The alarm was raised by a dog trained by the British military to detect explosives.
Police said they had evacuated between 300 and 400 people from a 200-metre (yards) radius around the car and said the evacuees were sheltering in a nearby school.
They said an underground gas pipe running under the car had been cut off for safety's sake.
